visual.name: zentrixSankeyPro
visual.description: Flow, journey and variance analysis for Power BI. A Sankey that analyses connections — automatic journey building, path analysis, clutter control and comparison — not just draws them.

dataRoles.description: Mode A. The 'from' end of each flow — a category column of node names. One row = one link. Bind Source + Destination for classic source→destination Sankey data.
dataRoles.name: source

dataRoles.description: Mode A. The 'to' end of each flow. Self-links (source = destination) and repeated pairs are aggregated, never errors.
dataRoles.name: destination

dataRoles.description: Mode B — Automatic Journey Builder. Drop 2+ stage columns (Stage 1, Stage 2, …) in order and the visual converts consecutive stages into links automatically — no calculated source/destination table needed. Takes priority over Source/Destination when bound.
dataRoles.name: stages

dataRoles.description: Optional. Numeric weight per row; drives link thickness. Defaults to a count of 1 per row when unbound.
dataRoles.name: value

dataRoles.description: Optional. A category per link; drives link colour + legend in category colour mode.
dataRoles.name: linkCategory

dataRoles.description: Optional. A category for the Source node of each row; drives node colour in category mode.
dataRoles.name: nodeCategory

dataRoles.description: Optional. A numeric sort key per node; when Node ordering = Custom order field, nodes within each stage sort by it ascending. Wrap a plain sort column in a measure (e.g. MIN(Table[SortOrder])) to use it here.
dataRoles.name: nodeOrder

dataRoles.description: Optional. A semantic icon token per Source node (e.g. 'zx:person', or a plain type word like 'customer'). Drawn on the node in 'By field' icon mode.
dataRoles.name: nodeIcon

dataRoles.description: Optional. A base64 data: URI per Source node (a logo / photo column). Only data: URIs render — external URLs are ignored to keep the visual certified.
dataRoles.name: nodeImage

dataRoles.description: Optional. A prior-period / budget / scenario value per row — unlocks Compare mode: variance labels, colour-by-variance, and new/changed-flow insights.
dataRoles.name: comparison

dataRoles.description: Optional. Extra measures shown in link/node hover cards, alongside the built-in flow metrics.
dataRoles.name: tooltips
